typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('9/11/2025 1:03:12 PM')),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BudgetName as string,
		BudgetGroup as string,
		BudgetStartDate as string,
		BudgetEndDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYear as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearName as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate as string,
		BudgetCurrency as string,
		BudgetAmount as decimal(18,0),
		BudgetExchangeRate as decimal(18,0),
		BudgetAmountDefaultCurrency as string,
		BudgetTotalForecastAmount as decimal(25,0),
		BudgetProcessingAmount as decimal(22,0),
		BudgetPaidAmount as decimal(18,0),
		BudgetScheduledAmount as decimal(21,0),
		BudgetPreapprovedAmount as decimal(23,0),
		BudgetRefundAmount as decimal(18,0),
		BudgetRemainingAmount as decimal(21,0),
		BudgetQuantity as string,
		BudgetCategory as string,
		BudgetID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(SnapShot_Asof_Date = $RunDate,
		Snapshot_Active_Flag = 'Y') ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		BudgetEndDate as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearName as string,
		BudgetProcessingAmount as integer,
		BudgetTotalForecastAmount as integer,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BudgetID as string,
		BudgetScheduledAmount as integer,
		BudgetQuantity as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate as string,
		BudgetExchangeRate as integer,
		BudgetPreapprovedAmount as integer,
		BudgetFiscalYear as string,
		BudgetCurrency as string,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate as string,
		BudgetAmount as integer,
		BudgetRefundAmount as integer,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG as string,
		BudgetAmountDefaultCurrency as string,
		BudgetCategory as string,
		BudgetStartDate as string,
		BudgetPaidAmount as integer,
		BudgetGroup as string,
		BudgetRemainingAmount as integer,
		BudgetName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BudgetEndDate,
		BudgetFiscalYearName,
		BudgetProcessingAmount,
		BudgetTotalForecastAmount,
		SNAPSHOT_AS_OF_DATE = SnapShot_Asof_Date,
		BudgetID,
		BudgetScheduledAmount,
		BudgetQuantity,
		BudgetFiscalYearEndDate,
		BudgetExchangeRate,
		BudgetPreapprovedAmount,
		BudgetFiscalYear,
		BudgetCurrency,
		BudgetFiscalYearStartDate,
		BudgetAmount,
		BudgetRefundAmount,
		SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_FLAG = Snapshot_Active_Flag,
		BudgetAmountDefaultCurrency,
		BudgetCategory,
		BudgetStartDate,
		BudgetPaidAmount,
		BudgetGroup,
		BudgetRemainingAmount,
		BudgetName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
